digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verify workflow
propositions: Ubuntu default-suite cells occupy 1,812 runner-seconds per Verified run (py3.11=615s, py3.12=634s, py3.13=563s) and remain material contributor to queue contention despite macOS being completion critical path at 22m15s

Bridge cadence test repeatedly parses the same workflow YAML 1,440 times inside a comprehension loop, consuming 7.653s of parse cost that can be eliminated by hoisting schedule-load outside the minute-check comprehension while preserving exhaustive uniform-cadence proof

Pandoc corpus and hardening tests invoke the real binary 3,421 times in two suites combined, where legacy subprocess duplication can be replaced with immutable static expected outputs (proven safe against 883 out of 884 units by mutation) while retaining all 884 live product conversions to honor ADR 0095

AST provenance fixture setup consumes 46–55s in Ubuntu cells by repeatedly rediscovering caller/parent relationships; building indices once per process preserves all 24 assertion tuples and guards while eliminating redundant ast.walk iterations

Complexity-lock policy evaluation runs identically in every Ubuntu/macOS matrix cell (52–55s per cell) and can be moved once into the existing lint job, eliminating four duplicate evaluations of the same OS/Python-invariant policy

Gerrit Verify jobs with `if: always()` status checks do not respect workflow cancellation when a patchset is superseded, causing stale runs to retain the concurrency slot and delay replacement runs by 25+ minutes until natural termination
